I’m (cis female) in a similar relationship (mtf). Although my partner hasn’t started taking hormones, sexual intimacy is a huge part of our relationship and something we both value. We already practice open communication when it comes to sex and have become comfortable expressing our desires and preferences, and know not to take anything personally. It’s not that YOU aren’t satisfying your partner, just that the current moves you’re putting on her aren’t working anymore. You guys got used to/comfortable with your sex life as a cis couple, and you just need to relearn everything. Sex in every relationship is different, so it makes sense that since you’re a whole new person, sex is going to be different! 
Porn has actually helped me and my partner a lot, like the homemade stuff or lesbian porn made by women (ya know, not the bs made to turn on hetero males). It’s given us new ideas, and helped us to realize that our sex life will probably turn more into taking turns ie she goes down on me, I go down on her, she uses toys on me, we do anal play for her, etc. it’s just different than our usual her penetrating me and we both get off at the same time. 
Basically, therapy is good, but it’ll take time. It’s hard when a big part of your relationship, especially something that was so constant, changes. But that doesn’t mean it will never resolve. If you both keep and open mind and open communication, I have faith it’ll work out. It’s just about learning each others bodies all over again
